verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the DGX B200 as 8 B200 GPUs with 1,440 GB of memory, linked by two 5th-gen NVLink switches at 14.4 TB/s aggregate bandwidth. NVIDIA also positions it within DGX SuperPOD turnkey data-center infrastructure, with cluster-level management software and NeMo multi-node training; hands-on community reports corroborate the NVLink/NVSwitch fabric on HGX B200 systems. Missing for 10: detailed rack-scale deployment specs beyond the one-line SuperPOD mention, and documented inter-node (InfiniBand/RDMA) fabric bandwidth.
